summary: Reviewed read-only facts, explicit answer fields, version writability, shared settings/brief validators and release-file scope inclusion. No checks, models or remote effects run while planning. Malformed/authority inputs are refused; history and caller answers remain untouched. Generated settings and brief use existing intake and complete a real local Git release through a deterministic native CLI worker with verification, critic, readback and cleanup. Read-only planner access is included in the existing worker command guard; mutation restrictions remain intact. Ready denotes valid configuration, not live provider availability or execution permission. Current declared checks, candidate release gate, ordinary clone checks and exact template pairing passed. Final tag/readback are downstream gates.
